titulo: One topic, different audiences: promoavatar and promoavatar3
hero_alt: A grid of twelve vertical screens, each showing a different audience, on an editing desk.
lead: The same topic won’t persuade a young person and a retiree in the same way. promoavatar writes a script for each of 12 audiences; promoavatar3 writes three for the same audience: reach, authority, and promotional. In both, the bot writes and stops. You approve before spending on the avatar and rendering.
objetivo: plan 3 videos for the same audience (reach, authority, promotional) with the two gates and each avatar’s contract title.

aprende.t: The 12 audiences and what motivates each one
The two gates: before the avatar and before rendering
Why the video title is a contract

secoes.sub: Four phases and two gates. The pipeline stops at the gates and only moves forward when you approve.

nos.detalhe: The agent writes one script per audience and sends each one in the chat with the video’s exact title. This is the first gate: you review, then type /aprovar. Changing the cover at this point is free.

Who generates the avatar video. By default, that’s you in the HeyGen studio. There are routes where the bot generates it (studio script, credits, API), but only one per flow: two would generate the same video twice.
Find the video in the studio by its exact title and download it. One character off and nothing is found. Second gate: you check the downloaded avatars before using up the render queue.
Build the 9:16 reel and deliver it to that audience’s channel. Delivery is the last step in the pipeline: the canal field for each audience in flow.json sets the destination.

secoes.legenda: Approving first is better than retrying later: avatar and render cost money and can’t be undone. The first gate protects your avatar spend; the second protects your render spend.

secoes.titulo: Three videos for the same audience (promoavatar3)
secoes.sub: Publish in this order: reach → authority → promotional.

texto: Goal: stop the scroll and get shared.
CTA: comment or share. Never promotional.
Goal: teach something concrete and get saved.
CTA: save, follow, or try it.
Goal: connect the pain point to the solution.

everyday people, young people, professionals, women, entrepreneurs, technicians, 40+, 60+, educators, creators, people looking for a new job, and families. Each audience has its own trigger and channel.

exemplo.texto: Your experience goes further when you multiply it with AI.

secoes.sub: Bot commands (inemaccbot). For your channel, the key pattern is: filter, review the plan, approve.

blocos.conteudo:
# review the plan without spending anything (does not add to the queue)
/promoavatar3 <assunto> | alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro | sombra

# run for just one audience, across all three types
/promoavatar3 <assunto> | alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro

# after reviewing the text
/aprovar C#7

promoavatar:   A<N>-<publico>-v1        ex.: A8-mulheres-v1
promoavatar3:  C<N>-<publico>-<tipo>-v1 ex.: C7-jovens-pro-v1

The download matches by exact equality. Short suffixes (alc, aut, pro):

abas.html:
• promoavatar: one video per audience, 12 audiences. Reference A#N.
  • promoavatar3: three videos per audience (reach, authority, promo), 36 possible targets. Reference C#N. The usual way to filter is | alvos=.
  • They are separate systems: changing one does not affect the other.

| prompt=viral: reach above all. No brand, no course, and no inema.club in the spoken lines; always use an engagement CTA, with a flexible length of 15 to 45 s. The final clip shows only the brand, so it does not compete with the request to comment.

secoes.sub: The avatars are in the studio. The download looks for each one by its exact title.

msg.inicio: 5 avatars are ready in the studio. Click "Download and assemble".
msg.rodando: Looking for each video by its exact title, downloading, and assembling the reel.
msg.parou: Interrupted. Anything being downloaded goes back in the queue for the next run.
msg.retoma: Resumed: reels that are already done are not made again.
msg.fim: All reels delivered to the audience channel.
msg.fimfalha: One video was not found: in the studio, it was saved as "C7-40mais-alcance-v1". A title outside the contract never matches.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative browser simulation. The failure is intentional: a title typed from memory, with the longer suffix.

exercicios.texto: Write meus-3-videos.md for an audience in your niche, publish in this order: reach → authority → promotional, and note the comments on each one.
exercicios.pronto: all three were published with titles that match the contract, and you know which one got the most comments.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: When does changing a reel's cover image cost nothing?
opcoes: After the reel has been assembled.
At the text gate, before any avatar or render.
perguntas.explica: At the text gate, no avatar, image, or render has been created yet. After that, changing it means assembling the reel again.

perguntas.p: What is the CTA for a reach video?
opcoes: Comment or share, never a sales CTA.
Subscribe to the channel and the course.
perguntas.explica: Reach content aims to stop the scroll and get shared. The invitation to visit the site belongs in the promotional video.

perguntas.p: The video was saved in the studio as "C7-jovens-promocional-v1". What happens during the download?
opcoes: It is not found: the title must be exactly C7-jovens-pro-v1.
The bot fixes the name automatically.
It downloads the version without captions.
perguntas.explica: The download matches by exact text. That’s why the chat sends the finished title, so you don’t have to type it from memory.

opcoes: To see the plan (phase × target × queue) without queueing anything or spending anything.
perguntas.explica: With “| sombra,” the bot only prints the plan. That’s how you check a new topic before spending GPU time.
